attributes.title: browse_tags
attributes.description: Browses one folder level of the tag tree under a given path and lists its immediate children (name, full path, whether it has children, tag/data type). Use this to discover what tags exist before reading or charting them. If you do not know which provider to use, ask -- providers are wrapped in []. Defaults to the [default] provider root if no path is given.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The folder path to browse, e.g. '[default]Exchange/Alarm Flood/Site1'. Paths without a [provider] prefix are assumed to be in [default]. Omit to browse the [default] provider root.
